Element.Description: Status-message lifetime, including the final one-second fade. Zero disables the automatic timeout. Also supplies the duration passed to Message Box display.
Replaces the status-window text and restarts its typewriter effect. When disabled, the new text is appended on a new line if the window already contains text.
Includes player 1 in the recipients of a status message. Use Originator replaces this selection when the message originator is a player.
Includes player 2 in the recipients of a status message. Use Originator replaces this selection when the message originator is a player.
Includes player 3 in the recipients of a status message. Use Originator replaces this selection when the message originator is a player.
Includes player 4 in the recipients of a status message. Use Originator replaces this selection when the message originator is a player.
Reveals status-message text with the typewriter effect. Use Originator forces this effect on when it selects a player from the incoming message.
Sends the status message only to the originating player and enables its typewriter effect. If the originator is not a player, Player 1 through Player 4 and Type Out retain their configured values.
Chooses a status message or a paused message box when an active HUD memo receives SetToZero. Deactivate fades out a status message.
String table displayed by the memo. Status messages read entry 0; Message Box display receives the string-table asset.
